title: Kinhold Update: Finalizing an art style and testing the group hunting rules
author: SweetKarmaz
selftext: Kinhold is being made with Claude Code for all code in the game, but the art is from Polytope's line. This clip is a demonstration of how your villagers take down predators on their own. They make sure and equip themselves with at least basic armor and weapons, and then hunt the predator - and as you can see, based on the predator there is no guarantee they will survive! This hunt can be triggered by a few factors: The predator is getting too close to your village, or has already started attacking and killing villagers; You have set crafting orders that require meat and are not ranching enough, so they are hunting all available animals for their resources. Blood and body ragdolls have been improved, but still working on some of the animations.

replies.author: SweetKarmaz
replies.body: Thank you! The automation work for the villagers is getting fairly complex and has taken a few months to get right, but I think its almost there. There are priorities for building, crafting, resource gathering, hunting, ranching, farming, hauling, leveling the ground to make it easier for future expansion, etc.
